name: Ranger Kit

intro.text: Shh, you'll scare the crake. Henderson is a World Heritage Site and I am the only person here with a clipboard. Prepare to be audited.

win: You were careful, I'll give you that. Mind the rubbish on the way back.
after: Pick up three pieces on your way off the beach. It won't make a dent, but it makes a difference to you.
